styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small chair with a dark bluish frame and a red seat/back. Only 9 distinct colours in total, against 14 for the bench, 11 for the hedge and 38-40 for the stall and well. Its 17% flat-fill coverage is above every reference except the cheese stall (13%), and the references that are thin or small (bench, lamp, hedge) sit at 0%. The dark edge pixels are only 13% neutral, so the outline leans toward the material tone and does not read as a sticker line. Each material ramp is shallow, about 3 steps: dark frame, mid red and a lighter red patch. That is below the roughly 5 steps on the bench slats or the stall. The seat and back show large flat red areas with little grain or per-part highlight. Next to the bench it looks flatter and thinner, so it is a borderline fail on shading depth and flat fills.
